parameters.name: X-Notify-Receiver

schema.description: Conditional conversation capability, additional to application Bearer auth. Required for receiver verification and protected conversation content, sending, tasks, claims, renewals, reports and monitor acknowledgements. Legacy requests remain valid without this header. Pairing exchange omits it; registration and metadata follow docs/integration/RECEIVERS.md. Proves capability possession, not AI host/chat identity. Never log the token.
